result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the module compiles, but I could not run the CLI to check the help output or an end-to-end landscape run. This sandbox asked for approval on every `java` and `git diff` call, so I verified by reading the code plus the offline compile only.

Changes:

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE = "analyzeLandscape"` with a description that says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands, same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview, and it reuses `getUpdateLandscapeOptions()`, so the options are identical.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape(args)` method. In its `-help` branch, `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own name and description, and `updateLandscape -help` prints its original usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Landscape" section describing both commands and the `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` usage. This is a new section, not an edit to an existing one.

`mvn -q -o -pl cli compile` succeeded. Nothing is committed.
